doc: Lane brutality: the one-shot signature kills of the advanced weapons on humans (features/combat/kills). A row fires when a lethal hit from `weapon` lands on a human; style picks the kill (gib = the body blown into its rig parts). Speeds in m/s, spin in deg/s, timings in 60 Hz ticks. Under --gore=reduced no row dismembers: the victim falls with the standard death.

kills.doc: Rocket launcher: the body blown apart along the blast into its six rig parts (head with the hat, torso, both arms, both legs) that spin, bounce and slide, a red spray fan and ink splat, a scorch mark at the burst.

Hand cannon: the victim is blown off their feet in one piece, flies back along the shot, lands and slides on a long blood smear while the cap spins off; an exit spray fans out behind the body. No scorch.

Fire (the flamethrower's long burst, and every fire death: molotov, fire patch, burning; gunplay's payload weapon `burn`): the victim, already running ablaze, stops as a charred ink silhouette with cream ember cracks, smokes where it stands, then crumbles into drifting ash flakes onto an ash heap over a soot scorch. No blood.

Electro gun: the bolt locks the victim in a stiff convulsion while an X-ray flash strobes his skeleton (weapon-art's sticker) inside cream arcs, then he drops stiff along the shot, scorched, smoke rising from the collar. No blood. Under --reduced-motion no strobe and no shake.

Katana: one clean diagonal slash cuts the body in two along the blade's line (shoulder to hip). Both halves of the real rig slide apart off the cut on red smears, a raw red edge on each, the blood fanning out along the cut in the swing's direction; a cream slash streak marks the blade's path. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole.

Plasma rifle: the bolt burns a clean round hole through the torso (the street shows through it), its edge glowing hot cream inside an ink rim and cooling to a charred brown over 1.5 s; the victim drops back along the shot, cauterised: no blood. The bolt flies on (gunplay's projectile).

Plasma sword: the katana's diagonal cut with a hot blade: the two halves of the real rig slide apart, their cut edges cauterised (a hot cream band in a heat bloom, no red), no blood and no smears; the cream slash streak marks the blade.

Chainsaw: the grind. The saw bites into the victim, who stays held on it shaking for most of a second while blood spurts back off the chain in a continuous spray and cream sparks fly off the teeth; then the body falls apart in two halves, cut straight along the saw's push, on red smears with a raw red edge. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole.

Ray gun: the victim locks up glowing, then dissolves in rings: the body is eaten from its outline inward by a hot cream ring while gold echo rings ripple out and glowing motes fall, leaving a pile of glowing dust with the empty uniform crumpled on it and the cap beside it. No blood. Under --gore=reduced the victim falls whole.
